summary: Master CMBS, RMBS, and structured finance. Learn waterfall modeling, credit enhancement, and regulatory compliance in this 5-day practitioner-led course.
lede: Real estate securitization turns pools of property-related loans into securities, while structured finance covers how those securities are designed and assessed. For real estate investment, underwriting, and finance professionals, the course covers assessing loan quality with debt-service coverage and loan-to-value measures, modeling payment waterfalls, and stress-testing tranche structures. It also addresses credit enhancement, SPV governance, and investor reporting.
audienceIntro: This program is designed for professionals who operate at the intersection of real estate investment and global capital markets.
modules: Rating Agency Methodology and Stress Testing
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of real estate finance, including property valuation and basic mortgage mechanics. Proficiency in financial modeling using Excel is required for the technical exercises. Prior experience in investment banking, corporate finance, or real estate investment is highly recommended.
